<div class="pvme-exact-guide">
<h1 id="corporeal-beast" class="pvme-source-title"><nowiki>Corporeal Beast</nowiki></h1>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><pvme-image src="https://img.pvme.io/images/HikgVgk3I1.png" alt="" title="" kind="media" /></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="introduction"><ins><nowiki>Introduction</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>The Corporeal Beast is a boss unlocked from completing the </nowiki>[https://runescape.wiki/w/Summer's_End <nowiki>Summer's End</nowiki>]<nowiki> quest. Summoning familiars cannot be used at this boss, however a legendary pet can be used here.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="mechanics"><ins><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div style="background-color: rgb(0, 153, 255)"></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><u><nowiki>Mechanics</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Auto Attacks</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Only uses magic attacks if you are outside of melee distance.
⬥ Uses magic and melee attacks if you are in melee distance.
    • Protection prayers only partially reduce damage rather than halve it
    • Magic attacks will do an AOE splash on their target in a 3x3 square.
​
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>Core</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Occasionally, a dark core will spawn and jump towards its target.
⬥ The core will do constant typeless damage while nearby.
    • Damage will stop when you step more than 1 square away.
    • Will heal the boss unless it is killed or you step away from it.
​
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><nowiki>

</nowiki></div><nowiki>


</nowiki></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div></div>
<nowiki>

</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
<div class="pvme-source-section">
<h2 id="general"><ins><nowiki>General</nowiki></ins></h2>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>Any weapon that isn't a </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Spear</nowiki></strong><nowiki> will deal half damage, so </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Melee</nowiki></strong><nowiki> is the recommended style that should be used at this boss.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line"><nowiki>⬥ It Is recommended to teleport out </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/1032540079589163049.png?v=1" alt="warsretreatteleport" title="warsretreatteleport" kind="icon" /><nowiki> after every kill to reset Abilities, Health and Prayer.</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>
<p class="pvme-source-line pvme-source-spacer"><nowiki>​</nowiki></p>
<nowiki>
</nowiki>

</div>
